Resolves #19451

🌿 *ADR 0038 can no longer tell a reader that memory content waits on a grant no read path ever checks.*

ADR 0038 now names the two carriers of agent content. The first is per-target grants: `CAN_READ_INBOX_OF` is live, and the memory and session scopes are marked reserved, as `MemoryCoreMcpAuth.md` already marks them. The second is the deployment's content-sharing policy. Under its default `team`, raw memories have been deployment-wide since #12527, while summaries stay an additive commons that keeps another tenant's private rows out. §2.3's coherence invariant is scoped to grant edges. The new §2.3.1 records D#19440's decision: an explicit, read-only team A2A observation on the private single-operator deployment, with its local-PAT residual, clamp, retained history and invalidation. The credential-use wording (§2.5, ledger rows 1 and 3), §4's rejected alternatives and the Fleet Manager Architecture guide's D3 follow. This is decision text only; the Brain #921 runtime merges after it.

Decision Record impact: amends ADR 0038.

Evidence: L2 (docs: source comparison at Brain `197e659a` plus a portal render of the touched guide) → L2 required (#19451 carries decision ACs only; runtime and installed acceptance belong to neomjs/neo-agent-brain#921 and neomjs/neo-agent-institution#490).
